node.title: DSP8: split-pencil/line-fiber correlation bound
node.statement: At every official row in n^2 <= p <= 6^{n/4}, with C_M=3*2^(-2/3), Q_n=(n-1)(n-2), and S_A=sum over antipodal P>=25 targets of R(t): 10K_25^0+17K_25^A+68S_A+68C_M n^(5/3)<=750n^2-255Q_n. Mattarei's arbitrary-coefficient Fermat-curve Corollary applies to both twisted quotient fibers and the combined cube-preimage fiber. It lowers the complete raw nodal payment to <116n^2 or <498n^2 according as gcd(3,p-1)=1 or 3. The exact remaining uniform smooth target is 10G_sm^0+17G_sm^A<=(36086/25)n^2, or equivalently 10K_sm^0+17K_sm^A<=(18043/50)n^2; the one-root branch permits 45636/25 in raw normalization. The target-independent estimate 25(10K_25^0+17K_25^A)<=12134n^2 suffices. The accident-depth compiler proves that exclusion of any rectangle (P,R)>=(19,18),(21,16),(25,12),(29,8),(33,4) closes C36'. Its original fixed-order endpoint is Mbar_(3),6,33^0+(53/42)Mbar_(3),6,33^A<=(583/272)n^2 with rho_3=(R-3)_+; the wider rho_1 analytic endpoint has constant 2385/272. The joint-star/depth and single-quotient compilers give twelve exact disjoint-moment alternatives, one at every integer corner (P,R)>=(25,12),(26,11),...,(35,2),(36,1). The coordinate-minimal last row is Dbar_17^0+(29/22)Dbar_17^A<=(29/153)B_par (uniformly, Dbar_17^0+(29/22)Dbar_17^A<=(234697/48960)n^2); its survivors have degree-eight/six pure distance-six stars and one quotient lift. Its star-coupling ideal is center-independent and stays nonzero for a zero coupling, so no anchor designation is required. The exact quotient-index-free candidate support is p|s_(n,35)^X iff Dbar_17>0, with s_(n,35)^X|s_(n,18)^X. Its radical support decomposes into 3(n-s-1) Galois-orbit annihilators; at n=8192 these are 24,534 independent blocks of degree at most 4,096, with total degree unchanged. Every block has a unique formula-generated (j,sign,w) ID and an explicit cyclotomic-resultant or normalized-reciprocal polynomial, so no quotient-orbit enumeration is needed; reciprocal support is not identified. Exact scalar elimination may be replaced by the complete three-resultant gcd superset: 73,602 ordinary resultants at n=8192, followed by full factorization and exact false-positive filtering. More sharply, the coefficient content of one cutoff-35 Taylor resultant per block has exactly the scalar annihilator's odd prime radical, with maximum auxiliary degree 143,360. The preceding (35,2) row has the older smaller normalized allowance, an incomparable rectangle, two lifts, and one spoke. The twelve rows are alternatives and cannot be mixed. The proved rich factorial-moment compiler gives further sufficient estimates 25(10F_25^0+17F_25^A)<=48536n^2 or 425M_21<=48536n^2. FALSIFIER: one official row violating a selected sufficient inequality kills that analytic route, not necessarily C36 itself. Minted 2026-07-19 at the C36 amber ceremony (alt leaf, gate=any). || F-ROUND 1 EXECUTED against the former stronger target: SURVIVED-VACUOUSLY (2026-07-19; packet notes/dsp8r1_fround1_20260719/, 25 Modal apps; catches #288-#295): no measured row has a retained P>=25 target; richness saturates at P=20. Round 2 must be constructive through smooth correlation or collision-norm/coupled-ideal templates, not a broad scan.
